messages:
nina_pm: Quick sync  we need a compact checklist for Marketplace go-live next week. Items: press embargo handling, landing + tracking tags, SI enablement KB, hardware validation window, and SKU/billing mapping. Who can take which?

sam_p: I can coordinate with the partner on assets and the SKU mapping. Need to confirm whether partner will provide a short exec quote + one hero screenshot. Also ask partner for their legal-approved embargo time.

oliver_se: I'll take SI enablement KB. For integrations checklist: manifest, sample deployment (Helm/CloudFormation), SSO settings, and event webhook contract. Prefer to ask for a small test app they can deploy into our staging tenant.

marc_ops: Staging info: https://staging-marketplace.redwood-internal/ (creds in 1Password -> Marketplace/MarketStaging). Quick package submit example for partners:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-marketplace.redwood-internal/api/v1/packages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" \
  -F "package=@partner-package.tar.gz" \
  -F "manifest=@manifest.yaml" \
  -F "tenant_id=staging-90"\n```
Also landing/tracking snippet (add to head):
```
<!-- GA4 gtag -->
<script async src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-XXXXXXX"></script>
<script>window.dataLayer=window.dataLayer||[];function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}gtag('js', new Date());gtag('config','G-XXXXXXX',{ 'send_page_view': false });</script>
```
Add data-layer events for partner_click, install_start, and billing_conversion.

press-bot: :spiral_calendar: Partner embargo requested for 2026-05-12 14:00 UTC. Assets due by 2026-05-11 18:00 UTC. Reply with "ack" when ready.

nina_pm: Proposed timeline:
- Wed 2026-05-06: Integrations KB + manifest template (oliver_se)
- Thu 2026-05-07: Press assets + hero copy (sam_p)
- Sun 2026-05-10: Final staging smoke (marc_ops)
- Mon 2026-05-11 17:00 UTC: Last asset freeze
- Tue 2026-05-12 13:00 UTC: Internal go/no-go (all)
- Tue 2026-05-12 14:00 UTC: Embargo lifts / publish
Can we all commit to these?

sam_p: Ack from partner side, will push hero images and quote by Thu.

oliver_se: Ack  I'll prepare a tiny test app repo with manifest + sample callbacks and open PR by EOD Wed.

marc_ops: I'll schedule the staging smoke and add the tracking QA checklist (page load, dataLayer events, attribution query).

nina_pm: Great  I'll update the runbook and add owners. Tagging Solutions Eng for deployment run. Closing thread for now, will post runbook link once updated. :rocket:
